title: tc-conversation-branches
description:
A conversation that forks when a past message is edited: a "‹ 2 / 3 ›" switcher on each message with siblings, and
the picked branch's messages below it.

messages.description: Every message of every branch, in the order they were written; each names its parent

selected.description: The picked child per parent id ("" for the first messages); a parent without an entry shows its newest child

editable.description: Your messages can be edited (default true; editable="false" turns it off)

replyActions.description: The actions under each reply (message-actions' keys); an empty list hides the bar

caption.description: The caption line (Standard: on the tray, Clean: the card's last row); unset, it sums up the branches

parentId.description: The message this one answers or follows; unset or null for the first message
